commitResults.messageTitle: Extend filter to support name, tag and address criteria
commitResults.messageBody:
filter now accepts [/name KEYWORDS] [/tag TAG]... [/address PHRASE]...
- Name keywords are whitespace separated; any keyword matching is enough
  (case-insensitive, partial match, same as find).

commitResults.messageTitle: Add sorted view of the person list to the model
commitResults.messageBody:
Wrap the filtered list in a SortedList so the displayed order can change
without reordering stored data. Because commands select persons by index in
the displayed list, the index shown always matches the person acted on.

- Model: updateSortedPersonList, sortPersonsByMostRecent,
  resetSortedPersonList.
- PersonComparators: by name (case-insensitive, asc/desc) and by priority
  (most urgent first or last; untagged always last; ties by name).
- Most recent is the reverse of the order persons were added.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

sort changes the displayed order without reordering stored data, and works on
top of any filter:
- sort priority [asc|desc]: desc (default) is HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW; asc is the
  reverse. Persons without a priority tag are always last.
- sort name [asc|desc]: asc (default) is A to Z.
- sort recent: most recently added person first.

list now also clears the sort order, restoring the order persons were added.
